title: UOP platform access records — Flock data held on SMPD's behalf
summary:
Asked for Flock-platform records concerning SMPD's UOP sharing arrangement: ALPR data SMPD disclosed to UOP, Flock platform audit-log entries about UOP, and account or configuration records.

The request cites MSA §4.1, Policy 463 (§§ 463.2, 463.5), and SOP 205.5.1 — three SMPD-sourced provisions that together describe Flock-held ALPR data as SMPD's records under Gov. Code § 7920.530.

Agency produced an event log ('SMPD4.20.2026_EVENTLOG') containing two UOP networkShare events from the sharing window.

policy_promises.quote: ALPR information shall not be sold, shared, or transferred except to another public agency
policy_promises.tests: What ALPR data records exist for SMPD's sharing window with UOP?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012328 received 'no responsive records' for UOP communications and removal records. This request asked Flock-platform-side records that the Department holds via its Flock account.
W012328's follow-up answer was 'I did not locate a log of this information in the Flock platform' (Mar 2026). This request produced that log — the SMPD Flock platform event log (Apr 2026).

filed_because: Asks for the Flock-platform records covering SMPD's UOP sharing, on the basis that those records are held by Flock on SMPD's behalf and are SMPD records under the cited provisions.
notes:
Produced event log entries (as stated by the agency):
- 2026-02-12 04:51:19.301Z — create networkShare — Permissions: feedView — User: Phoenix O'Rourke
- 2026-02-28 04:09:40.789Z — delete networkShare — Permissions: Search, VMS, Hotlist — User: Steve Casazza

The two events list different permission scopes. Follow-ups W012664-050426 (lifecycle / current state) and W012674-050426 (authorization records for the 2/12 create) ask SMPD to clarify.
